title: HomeCare
shortDescription: Healthcare platform connecting patients with home healthcare professionals across Saudi Arabia through a mobile app and ASP.NET MVC portal.
description: HomeCare is a digital healthcare platform built for the Saudi Arabian market to connect patients with home healthcare professionals through a single, coordinated system. The solution combines a patient-facing mobile application with an ASP.NET MVC web portal for clinical and administrative teams. It supports the full care journey—from registration and service requests through appointments, treatment planning, billing, and medical history tracking—with a primary focus on physiotherapy (DPT) patients and home healthcare providers.
businessProblem: Home healthcare delivery was fragmented across phone calls, paper records, and disconnected schedules, making it difficult to assign clinicians, track care progress, and keep patients informed. Providers needed a centralized platform to manage appointments, collaborate on diagnosis, and maintain accurate clinical and financial records.
solution: HomeCare introduced a unified digital ecosystem where patients can register, request services, and communicate with doctors, while clinical teams manage assignment, diagnosis, treatment plans, and billing from dedicated portals. A collaborative diagnosis workflow enables doctors to review patient information together before recommending treatment, improving care quality and decision consistency.
responsibilities: Served as Full Stack .NET Developer across web portal and related platform modules
Built and enhanced ASP.NET MVC application features
Implemented frontend interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery
Developed backend business logic for clinical and operational workflows
Designed and maintained SQL Server database objects
Resolved defects and optimized existing modules for stability and performance
technicalHighlights: Dual-channel delivery via mobile app and ASP.NET MVC web portal
Role-based portals for administrators and doctors
Structured clinical workflow for multi-doctor diagnosis review
Integrated billing and medical history within a shared patient record
results: Delivered a production-ready healthcare platform that streamlined home care operations, improved clinician collaboration, and gave patients a clearer digital path from request to treatment and follow-up.
architecture: Centralized ASP.NET MVC web application with SQL Server as the system of record, supporting patient, doctor, and admin roles. Business logic orchestrates registration, scheduling, diagnosis collaboration, treatment planning, billing, and notifications across the web portal and mobile application.
features: Patient self-registration and profile management
Appointment scheduling and doctor assignment
Collaborative auto diagnosis workflow
Treatment planning and care coordination
Patient history and medical records management
Billing and payment tracking
Notifications for patients and care teams

title: Brass ERP
shortDescription: Complete Enterprise Resource Planning system for a Chinese electric bike manufacturer, covering HR, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, CRM, and operations.
description: Brass ERP is a complete Enterprise Resource Planning system developed for a Chinese electric bike manufacturing organization. The platform unifies the full operating model of the business—human resources, payroll, finance, procurement, inventory, warehouse, supply chain, production, quality, CRM, and administration—into one centralized enterprise system. The solution initially launched on ASP.NET MVC and later evolved through a phased modernization of selected modules to Angular with ASP.NET Web APIs, enabling a more scalable and API-driven architecture without disrupting core ERP operations.
businessProblem: Manufacturing, finance, HR, inventory, and commercial teams operated through fragmented processes with limited cross-department visibility. Leadership needed a complete ERP platform to standardize workflows, strengthen financial control, improve production planning, and create one reliable source of operational truth.
solution: Brass ERP delivered a full-suite ERP architecture that connects people, money, materials, and manufacturing into a single enterprise platform. Shared master data, configurable workflows, role-based security, dashboards, and reporting support end-to-end operations—from recruitment and attendance through procurement, production, warehouse control, sales, and financial close. Selected modules were modernized to Angular with REST APIs to improve maintainability and long-term extensibility.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained complete ERP business modules across HR, finance, inventory, and operations
Implemented features within the ASP.NET MVC enterprise architecture
Contributed to Angular migration of selected ERP modules
Built REST APIs to support modernized frontend workflows
Optimized SQL Server queries and transactional data access patterns
Sustained and enhanced existing ERP functionality in production
technicalHighlights: Complete ERP coverage across HR, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and CRM
Hybrid modernization path from ASP.NET MVC to Angular + Web API
Configurable workflow, security, and administration framework
SQL performance improvements for high-volume ERP transactions
results: Enabled a manufacturing organization to operate through one complete ERP platform—improving departmental coordination, financial visibility, inventory control, and production governance while establishing an API-ready foundation for continued modernization.
architecture: Complete enterprise ERP built initially as an ASP.NET MVC platform with SQL Server as the system of record, later extended with Angular frontends and ASP.NET Web APIs for migrated modules. Shared configuration, security, workflow, and reporting services support cross-department operations spanning HR, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, CRM, and administration.
features: End-to-end ERP operations across people, finance, materials, and manufacturing
Integrated HRM covering recruitment, attendance, leave, and payroll
Full financial controls including GL, AP, AR, cash, and banking
Procurement-to-pay and order-to-cash commercial workflows
Inventory, warehouse, and supply chain visibility
Production planning, manufacturing, and quality control
CRM, task, and workflow management
Executive dashboards, enterprise reporting, and role-based security

caseStudy.problem: A manufacturing enterprise needed one complete ERP to replace fragmented departmental systems.
challenges: Delivering broad ERP module coverage without sacrificing operational continuity

title: Shifili Multihead Production System
shortDescription: Textile manufacturing platform with machine integration, fabric inspection, defect detection, roll tracking, warehouse control, and accounts integration.
description: Shifili Multihead Production System is an enterprise textile manufacturing platform designed to digitize the shop floor and connect production reality to warehouse and commercial operations. The software communicates directly with industrial production machines to capture live output, support fabric inspection, detect defects, track rolls, manage grading, and synchronize production outcomes with warehouse, dispatch, and accounts workflows.
businessProblem: Textile manufacturers struggled to convert machine output into reliable operational records. Manual inspection notes, delayed roll tracking, and disconnected warehouse or accounts processes created quality risk, inventory gaps, and weak production visibility.
solution: The platform creates a closed-loop manufacturing system centered on machine integration and production intelligence. Live machine data feeds production monitoring, fabric inspection, and defect detection. Roll tracking and grade management convert quality outcomes into inventory-ready records, while warehouse, dispatch, and accounts integration extend production data into fulfillment and commercial control.
responsibilities: Led application development for the production platform
Designed manufacturing workflows from machine capture to dispatch and accounts
Built backend modules for monitoring, inspection, grading, and inventory
Designed the SQL Server database structure
Delivered production and operational reporting
Integrated industrial machine data into the software stack
technicalHighlights: Direct industrial machine integration for live production capture
Fabric inspection and defect detection workflows
Roll tracking and grade management for quality-controlled inventory
Warehouse, dispatch, and accounts integration from production events
deploymentEnvironment: On-premise / industrial plant environment with machine-connected services
results: Transformed textile production from manual recording into a connected manufacturing system—improving machine visibility, inspection consistency, roll-level inventory accuracy, and downstream warehouse, dispatch, and accounts alignment.
architecture: ASP.NET MVC application with SQL Server, supported by Windows Services that communicate with industrial textile machines. Production events flow through monitoring, fabric inspection, defect detection, roll and grade management, warehouse, dispatch, and accounts modules—creating an end-to-end manufacturing control loop.
features: Real-time machine integration and production monitoring
Fabric inspection and defect detection
Roll tracking with grade and quality classification
Warehouse and inventory synchronization from production output
Dispatch readiness linked to graded rolls and stock
Accounts integration for commercial follow-through
Production reporting for operational and management control

caseStudy.api: Service-based machine data ingestion with operational application modules.
caseStudy.performance: Continuous machine statistics capture supporting live production monitoring.

businessProblem: Dynamics 365 alone did not fully satisfy the organization's need for high-performance reporting, multi-channel commerce synchronization, and operational intelligence.
